text.zh_CN:
铅笔虽然方便，却只能用一次。自动铅笔可以存放最多十五管铅芯，手持右键打开笔内的替芯槽，放入铅芯即可；关闭界面后，铅芯仍保存在笔里。
将它放入现代研究台的书写工具槽后，书写时会自动使用铅芯。铅芯偶尔会折断，因此最好准备一些备用。
text.en_US:
A pencil is convenient, but disposable. A mechanical pencil stores up to fifteen leads. Use it in your hand to open its refill slot and insert leads; they remain in the pencil when the screen closes.
Place it in the modern research desk to write. Leads are consumed automatically and can occasionally snap, so keep some spares.

text.zh_CN:
将两块铁锭竖直放在一管铅芯上方，可以合成自动铅笔。新合成的笔里已有一管铅芯。
将两块木炭竖直排列，可以合成六管铅芯。
text.en_US:
Place two iron ingots vertically above one lead to craft a mechanical pencil. A newly crafted pencil contains one lead.
Two charcoal placed vertically make six leads.

subtitle.zh_CN: 可以更换铅芯的书写工具
